description: This file contains the implementation of the ElizaResponder class, a basic chatbot based on the ELIZA program that employs primitive natural language processing to simulate a Rogerian psychotherapist. It includes predefined responses, keyword detection, and simple phrase transformations.

classes.name: ElizaResponder
classes.description: A class implementing a simple ELIZA-like chatbot that responds to user input based on keyword matching and predefined questions.

methods.name: ElizaResponder
methods.description: Constructor initializing keyword response indices for the chatbot.

methods.name: elzTalk
methods.description: Generates a response to an input string by matching keywords and selecting an appropriate predefined question or response.
